listed_quote.quote: NexPoint Hospitality Trust (“ NHT ” or the “ REIT ” 1 ), (TSX-V: NHT.U) and NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust (NYSE: NXDT)

announcement.quote: NexPoint Hospitality Trust to be Acquired by NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust

deals.notes: Target is a hospitality REIT (units on the TSX Venture Exchange, not a closed-end fund or BDC); acquirer is an NYSE-listed real estate trust. Not a listed closed-end pair, so outcome set to not_a_listed_pair. For information only: the 2025-04-17 8-K (0001437749-25-012294) states 'NexPoint Hospitality Trust Completes Going Private Transaction with NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust', and the 2025-02-21 425 reports unitholder approval of the merger.

problems: Many 8-K excerpts are only XBRL header text. The 2026 proxy filings and the 2026-06-02 8-K concern an annual meeting and a shareholder proposal to liquidate NXDT's assets (not approved), not a fund merger.
